dedupe_keys.name: geocodage numeros de voirie ville de dijon

description: Géocodage - Numéros de voirie - Ville de Dijon is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Punctual objects materializing the road numbers of the City of Dijon. Each number identifies the postal address. Each number is the physical location that allows access to a building or a group of buildings from a VOIE: it originates on the edge of the lane open to public traffic. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Geocoding - Road numbers - City of Dijon" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include administratif, géocodage, voies, ville de dijon, adresses. The listing shows 2015-09-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
